rows.title: 01 — IDENTITY & DESCRIPTION
rows.description: Identify a manufacturer, reusable model, particular unit and API identity without collapsing them.

rows.definition: The producer's manufacturer name; not who operates the current station.
A reusable model is not an individual physical device.

SensorML.note: Reference to more general process, not a literal model-name field.

CSAPI.note: Link to reusable kind description, not a product-model string.

rows.definition: No API UID should be silently interpreted as a physical serial.

SAPIENT.note: Software-only nodes may use this for license/product numbers; not always hardware.

rows.definition: Persistent identity of the described System—not a guaranteed equipment serial.

SensorML.note: Process identifier, scope must be distinguished.

CSAPI.note: URI distinct from the HTTP resource address and original serial.

rows.title: 02 — SYSTEM, EQUIPMENT & RELATIONSHIPS
rows.description: Describe the whole, physical constituents, separate connections, reporting participant and hosting context.

rows.definition: No single donor superclass has been adopted as the DIM root.

OPC.note: Devices may differ from the focal whole/station.

SOSA.note: SSN Systems need not be one physical enclosure.

SensorML.note: PhysicalSystem is a process-system construct; not universal root.

CSAPI.note: Can describe unlike System roles; not always one manufactured item.

rows.definition: One visible network node cannot be assumed identical to one physical device.

IEEE.note: A network-side processor role, not universally the whole sensor.

SAPIENT.note: May be software-only or compound, not automatically a physical sensing element.

rows.definition: Differentiate part-of from merely connected, hosted or digitally exposed.

IEEE.note: Only a physical part when source identifies hardware; not universal containment.

OPC.note: ComponentType is broader than a physical hardware part.

SensorML.note: Physical process-component association must be source-attested.

CSAPI.note: A subsystem resource is not automatically a separately manufactured chip.

rows.definition: A separately cabled ClimaVue is not necessarily a physical constituent of a CR1000X.

SensorML.note: Process/output connections, not necessarily electrical cable.

rows.definition: Station coordinates are not necessarily the individual probe coordinates.

OMS.note: Can include organizational grouping rather than physical platform.

SOSA.note: Hosting/attachment role differs from physical composition.

CSAPI.note: A System role typed as Platform; no universal mandatory Host.

rows.definition: Keep reusable procedure distinct from System, actual observation and result.

OMS.note: Method of observation, separate from performer.

SOSA.note: Broader procedure semantics; use when observing role is evidenced.

SensorML.note: SensorML ProcessMethod and OMS procedure need qualified translation.

CSAPI.note: Procedure resource is not evidence that an observation occurred.

rows.title: 03 — CHANNELS, OUTPUTS & OBSERVATIONS
rows.description: Separate physical/transducer channels, output fields, observable properties, performer and performed event.

rows.definition: No automatically equivalent CSAPI DataStream or SensorML output address.

IEEE.note: An addressable transducer channel, not a physical separate sensor.

rows.definition: A logger diagnostic field is not automatically a measurement.

SensorML.note: Process output definition; need SWE Common data types for fields.

CSAPI.note: DataStream schema is a carrier, not the physical channel.

rows.definition: Temperature of the outdoor air is different from temperature of a logger panel.

SOSA.note: Observed property associated with an Observation.

CSAPI.note: Collection property declaration, not necessarily the original channel.

rows.definition: Physical probe, logger and publishing server must not be silently conflated.

SOSA.note: Can be software/human; not always one physical probe.

CSAPI.note: Native System may be typed Sensor; averaged-result producer must be source-supported.

rows.definition: Manufacturer example data does not establish a performed event.

OMS.note: Act resulting in an original report; source time/quality matter.

SOSA.note: An observing act, not a type description.

CSAPI.note: Native structure must be valid and originally evidenced.

rows.title: 04 — CONFIGURATION & CONTROL
rows.description: Differentiate supported/default capabilities, applied/reported configuration and actual command execution.

rows.definition: An option a device supports isn't necessarily the one in use.

IEEE.note: Only sampling mode, not all equipment modes.

SensorML.note: Can be a configurable process mode.

SAPIENT.note: A declared mode, not proof it is active.

rows.definition: Don't promote a printed default to current effective state.

IEEE.note: Default of transducer channel sampling, not a universal device default.

SAPIENT.note: Declared default mode, not a verified current operating mode.

rows.definition: Keep source report time and subject; don't infer live state.

SAPIENT.note: A reported mode, not necessarily continuously current.

rows.definition: Supported command syntax ≠ an issued request.

SAPIENT.note: SAPIENT task request has source-specific targeting and behavior.

CSAPI.note: A Command is not itself proof of success or physical effect.

rows.definition: ACCEPTED is not COMPLETED, and COMPLETED is not measured physical effect.

SAPIENT.note: Task status code differences and identity must be preserved.

CSAPI.note: Reported status is not independently verified physical effect.

rows.title: 05 — SOURCE, EVIDENCE & REPRESENTATION
rows.description: Deliberate unmatched proposal rows: unsupported equivalence is not concealed by a blank cell.

rows.definition: Our proposed source/issuer/edition/locator/evidence standing is NOT a native obligatory field in these seven donors.

rows.dim: Original event and derived digital representation (proposed DIM)
rows.definition: Bennett two original events/four digital experimental copies need explicit provenance; no false equivalence asserted here.
display: Original event and derived digital representation (proposed DIM)
